title: Centre-to-centre framing spacings, by end use

citation.standard: Voluntary Product Standard PS 2-18, Performance Standard for Wood Structural Panels (effective 30 March 2019)
citation.publisher: U.S. Department of Commerce / National Institute of Standards and Technology; published by APA - The Engineered Wood Association, Form No. S350H
citation.where: §4.1.3, "Span rating", page 10, which defines a span rating as "an index number, based on customary inch units, that identifies the recommended maximum center-to-center support spacing for the specified end use under normal use conditions" and gives Wall 24 and Floor 24 o.c. as examples; together with the span ratings the standard's own performance tables are written against — Table 2 pp. 12-13 (Roof and Subfloor), Table 3 p. 15 (Single Floor) and Table 5 p. 20 (Wall). NOT read from the IRC: napkin does not transcribe adopted code tables, which is a decision for the project owner and blocks the code packs.

spacings.name: Wall - 16
spacings.derivation: Table 5, racking load performance criteria, lists the span rating "Wall - 16". By §4.1.3 a span rating is the recommended maximum centre-to-centre support spacing for that end use, so the studs are at 16 in on centre. This is the 16 in o.c. stud spacing, read from a standard rather than from the IRC.

spacings.name: Wall - 24
spacings.derivation: Table 5 lists the span rating "Wall - 24"; §4.1.3 gives Wall 24 as its own worked example of a span rating. Studs at 24 in on centre.

spacings.name: Roof - 16
spacings.derivation: Table 2, End Use - Span Rating column, lists Roof - 16. Rafters or trusses at 16 in on centre (§4.1.3).

spacings.name: Roof - 32
spacings.derivation: Table 2 lists Roof - 32. §4.1.3's own example, a span rating of 32/16, designates a roof span of 32 in and a subfloor span of 16 in.

spacings.name: Subfloor - 16
spacings.derivation: Table 2 lists Subfloor - 16. Joists at 16 in on centre (§4.1.3).

spacings.name: Single Floor - 16
spacings.derivation: Table 3, uniform load performance criteria, lists Single Floor - 16.

spacings.name: Single Floor - 24
spacings.derivation: Table 3 lists Single Floor - 24; §4.1.3 gives Floor 24 o.c. as a worked example.
